title: Apexspace footer
description: A charcoal footer over a faint full-bleed backdrop. Left: the wordmark, a full-width black contact bar with an arrow, a mono 'subscribe' label, an outlined email field with an arrow button and a small consent line. Right, from about 44%: four columns of uppercase mono links (white heading, grey links that turn white on hover) and a copyright line with social icons. On phones everything stacks: wordmark, link groups, contact, subscribe, socials, copyright.
notes: backdrop is a media slot (a faint line drawing in the original, cropped like object-fit: cover); empty shows a faint muted tint
the email field is a plain form: point action at your own endpoint
name: apexspace-footer
